subject: differential-equations
covers: A first course in ordinary differential equations: first-order methods, linear higher-order equations, Laplace transforms, linear and nonlinear systems, and numerical methods. Stops before partial differential equations and before the proofs of the existence theorems in depth.

packs.title: Basics of differential equations
packs.brief: What an ordinary differential equation is, its order, what a solution and a general solution are, initial value problems, and direction fields. Stops before any method for solving.

packs.title: Separable equations
packs.brief: First-order equations whose variables can be split to each side, solved by integration, with implicit solutions and solutions lost when dividing. Stops before exact equations.

packs.title: Exact equations and integrating factors
packs.brief: First-order equations written as a total differential, the test for exactness, recovering the potential function, and integrating factors that make an equation exact. Stops before linear equations.

packs.title: Linear first-order equations
packs.brief: First-order linear equations in standard form, solved with an integrating factor, Bernoulli equations reduced to linear form, and the split into transient and steady-state parts. Stops before modeling applications.

packs.title: First-order models
packs.brief: Growth and decay, Newton's law of cooling, mixing problems, and the logistic equation with a carrying capacity, each set up as a first-order equation. Stops before qualitative analysis.

packs.title: Existence and uniqueness of solutions
packs.brief: When an initial value problem has a solution and when that solution is unique, using the Lipschitz condition and the Picard-Lindelof theorem, with examples where uniqueness fails and the interval of a solution. Stops before the full proofs.

packs.title: Autonomous equations and the phase line
packs.brief: First-order autonomous equations, their equilibrium points, reading the phase line to decide stability, and sketching solutions from it. Stops before systems.

packs.title: Linear homogeneous equations of higher order
packs.brief: Linear equations of order n with the superposition principle, linear independence and the Wronskian, and fundamental sets of solutions. Stops before constant coefficients.

concepts.name: Linear differential equation of order n

packs.title: Constant-coefficient linear equations
packs.brief: Homogeneous linear equations with constant coefficients solved through the characteristic equation, for distinct real, repeated and complex roots. Stops before nonhomogeneous equations.

packs.title: Reduction of order and Euler equations
packs.brief: Finding a second solution from a known one by reduction of order, using the Wronskian to get it, and Cauchy-Euler equations with variable coefficients. Stops before nonhomogeneous equations.

packs.title: Nonhomogeneous linear equations
packs.brief: Nonhomogeneous linear equations with the complementary and particular solutions, the method of undetermined coefficients, and variation of parameters. Stops before applications to oscillators.

packs.title: Oscillations and resonance
packs.brief: Spring-mass systems, free and damped motion, forced oscillation, resonance, and the RLC circuit, all set up as second-order constant-coefficient equations. Stops before the Laplace transform.

packs.title: Power series solutions
packs.brief: Solving linear equations with variable coefficients as power series near an ordinary point, from the recurrence for the coefficients and the radius of convergence. Stops before singular points.

packs.title: The Laplace transform
packs.brief: The Laplace transform and its inverse, the transform of a derivative, the shifting theorem, and the Heaviside step function, with a table of common transforms. Stops before solving equations with it.

packs.title: Solving with the Laplace transform
packs.brief: Solving initial value problems with the Laplace transform, handling forcing by delta functions and step functions, and convolution. Stops before systems.

concepts.name: Laplace transform solution of an initial value problem

packs.title: Linear systems and eigenvalues
packs.brief: Writing linear first-order systems in matrix form and solving them with eigenvalues and eigenvectors. Stops before the phase portraits of two-dimensional systems.

packs.title: Phase portraits of linear systems
packs.brief: Classifying two-dimensional linear systems by eigenvalues as nodes, saddle points, spirals and centers, including the defective repeated-eigenvalue case. Stops before nonlinear systems.

packs.title: Nonlinear systems and linearization
packs.brief: Nonlinear autonomous systems, linearizing about an equilibrium with the Jacobian matrix, hyperbolic equilibria, limit cycles described qualitatively, and a predator-prey model. Stops before proofs of stability theorems.

packs.title: Numerical methods for first-order equations
packs.brief: Approximating solutions of initial value problems with Euler's method, the effect of step size, the improved Euler method, and the fourth-order Runge-Kutta method. Stops before error analysis.
